{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the relevant columns
print("Column names:", trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Confirm that 'arm' is the treatment indicator
print("Unique values in 'arm':", trial_df['arm'].unique())

# Check the response variable
print("Response distribution:", trial_df['responded'].value_counts())

# Compute response rates by group
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Extract treatment and control response rates
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_rate = response_rates['control']

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print results
treatment_effect, treatment_rate, control_rate"}
